attempts.summary: Created an SSH host CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca), signed the node's ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub with principals node1/NODE_IP/localhost, and configured sshd (HostCertificate directive in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-host-cert.conf) to present it. Verified a client trusting only the CA (via a known_hosts @cert-authority line, no pinned host key) connects successfully (host verification passes; only publickey auth fails as expected). Enabled and started the previously-disabled ssh service. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified ssh service active/enabled, cert files intact, and CA-based client trust still works post-restart.
